title: Ariyandcoder Special
description: A client side modpack for an optimized gameplay
body:
_A lightweight Fabric optimization modpack designed for low-end and mid-range PCs.
Boosts FPS, reduces stutter, and improves load times without changing vanilla gameplay._


## 🚀 What this modpack does

- Significantly improves FPS
 
- Reduces lag spikes and micro-stutter
  
- Speeds up world loading and chunk generation
  
- Optimizes memory and CPU usage
  
- Keeps the game vanilla-friendly

_No gameplay changes. No tech or magic mods. Just performance._

## 💻 Best suited for

✔ Low-end laptops and older PCs

✔ Integrated graphics (Intel / AMD iGPU)

✔ 4–8 GB RAM systems

✔ Players who want smoother vanilla Minecraft

‎ 

✖ Not intended for heavy shaders

✖ Not a content or progression modpack

## 🧩 Included optimization mods

**This pack carefully combines well-known and tested performance mods such as:**

- Lithium
  
- FerriteCore
  
- Sodium / VulkanMod **_[Sodium is not provided but is compatible with  all the mods]_**
  
- Entity Culling
  
- Dynamic FPS
  
- BadOptimizations

- And other supporting performance fixes...

_All mods are chosen for stability and compatibility._

## ⚠ Important notes

- VulkanMod may not work on all GPUs,
   
     ~ _If the game crashes on startup, try replacing VulkanMod with Sodium._
  
- Mods are updated as fixes and improvements are released 🌐
